title: vocabulary.json — the internal content vocabulary, as data

code.description: One internal content code. ACTIVE codes must appear, byte for byte, at every hard-coded site bin/check_vocabulary.py knows about — INTERNAL_CODES, FOCUS_CATEGORIES and the four SHELF_VOCAB literals. PROPOSED codes must appear at NONE of them: a code that is half-shipped is the failure this registry exists to make impossible.

id.description: The token that appears in shelfBlueprint arrays, focus categories and standards.json internalCodes. Stable forever — renaming one silently unpins every tagged page.

status.description: `active`: shipped to all six code sites and usable today. `proposed`: a QUEUE ENTRY, not a code — it must unblock a standards unit or supersede an existing code, and nothing may tag itself with it yet. `retired`: withdrawn; INV-IR2 applies, a withdrawal must leave a route.

unblocks.description: standards.json unit codes that become mappable the day this code ships. Every entry must be a real unit whose mappingStatus is 'blocked-on-vocabulary' and whose blockedByCode names THIS code — the checker verifies both directions, so a proposed code cannot claim a payoff the spine does not agree it has.

supersedes.description: Active code ids this one would replace — used for splits, e.g. safety-risk and safety-systems both supersede safety. Each must resolve to an active code in this file.

rationale.description: REQUIRED for proposed codes. Why this code and not a broadening of an existing one. A proposal nobody argued for is a proposal nobody can evaluate.
